title: Compact onboarding quickcards and annotated screenshot guide for Dedicated capacity
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and deliver a compact set of onboarding quickcards, annotated screenshot guide, and export-ready assets for the Dedicated capacity quickstart flow. Focus areas: initial capacity estimator, autoscale policy microflow, and SLA summary card. Goal is to provide a visual bundle that Product and Docs can use for the public release notes, in-product first-run tour, and help center screenshots.
acceptance_criteria: Three quickcard variants produced: Estimator, Autoscale Summary, SLA Snapshot
Annotated screenshots for each step of the capacity setup flow (desktop and tablet sizes)
Figma file with componentized quickcards and tokenized colors/spacing
PNG/JPEG exports in 2x and 3x for docs and release mailers
Microcopy reviewed and signed off by PM
Engineering has confirmed screenshot dimensions and CSS hooks for in-product capture
screenshots_to_capture: Capacity estimator: default view, filled example with 1M tokens/day
Autoscale policy modal: open with 'gradual scale' selected
Autoscale timeline: expanded view showing cooldown and min/max
SLA overview card: desktop and tablet variants showing latency / uptime row
First-run tour step: quickcard stacked with CTA highlighted
export_specs: PNG exports @2x for web docs, @3x for retina marketing banners
SVGs for illustrations and icons, optimized and cleaned for production
Separate background-free PNGs for overlay uses
All assets flattened and named using kebab-case: dedicated-quickcard-estimator-2x.png
a11y_considerations: Color contrast for SLA stat rows must meet AA (4.5:1)
Text sizes in quickcards should be >= 14px for body copy at desktop baseline
Provide descriptive alt text for every exported image in the release notes
Avoid conveyance of status by color alone; include icon and text labels
localization_notes: Designs should accommodate 30-40% longer strings for DE/FR/ES locales
Avoid hard-coded text in images; prefer component-based screenshots where possible
Provide template file with separate text layer for translation handoff
